# rights type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:rightsType`](gmeow-rightsType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/rightsType>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The kind(s) of intellectual-property right a statement concerns — one of the open [`gmeow:RightsType`](../classes/gmeow-RightsType.md) values (copyright, trademark, patent, industrial design, trade secret, related rights, moral rights, database right, plant breeders' rights). Non-functional: a statement may span several.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:RightsStatement`](../classes/gmeow-RightsStatement.md) -> [`gmeow:RightsType`](../classes/gmeow-RightsType.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:rightsType`](gmeow-rightsType.md) from [`gmeow:RightsStatement`](../classes/gmeow-RightsStatement.md) to [`gmeow:RightsType`](../classes/gmeow-RightsType.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:RightsStatement`](../classes/gmeow-RightsStatement.md), [`gmeow:RightsType`](../classes/gmeow-RightsType.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to tag the kind(s) of IP right a rights statement concerns — copyright, trademark, patent, trade secret, moral rights, database right, … — by referencing [`gmeow:RightsType`](../classes/gmeow-RightsType.md) values.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it for the copyright or trademark status ([`gmeow:copyrightStatus`](gmeow-copyrightStatus.md) / [`gmeow:trademarkStatus`](gmeow-trademarkStatus.md)) and avoid collapsing a multi-right statement to one type — it is non-functional, so several coexist.

### How to use

- Add one or more [`gmeow:rightsType`](gmeow-rightsType.md) values to a [`RightsStatement`](../classes/gmeow-RightsStatement.md) (non-functional); the values are aligned to Wikidata / WIPO by reference.

### Examples

- ex:photoRights [`gmeow:rightsType`](gmeow-rightsType.md) [`gmeow:rightsTypeCopyright`](../individuals/gmeow-rightsTypeCopyright.md), [`gmeow:rightsTypeMoralRights`](../individuals/gmeow-rightsTypeMoralRights.md).
